text:
Type: Data Protection complaint

Description: The complainant alleged that the controller requested excessive information, specifically, a selfie holding proof of address in front of the residence.

Outcome: Infringement of the principle of data minimisation as set forth in article 5(1)(c) of the GDPR.

Corrective Action: Reprimand and order to revise the controller’s internal procedure.
